title: adenostemma lavenia var. latifolium
intro: Adenostemma lavenia var. latifolium, commonly known as Blue Porterweed, is a plant species in the Lamiaceae family, native to tropical regions of Asia and the Pacific Islands. This plant is known for its health benefits, which include the treatment of respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma, as well as its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Blue Porterweed include acting as an expectorant, helping to relieve coughs and congestion, and its antiseptic properties aid in wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Adenostemma lavenia var. latifolium include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
